title: Improve text output formatting
description:
Enhance text output for better readability and usability:

Requirements:
- Show columns as actual columns (align layer headers, issue text)
- Empty horizontal line between disconnected components
- Better handle long titles (truncate with ... at consistent width)
- Add visual indicators: ✓ (ready), ⚠ (blocked), → (blocking others)
- Consider: show dependency count per issue

Review from spike:
- Current 50px bucket layering works correctly
- Component separation in Y-axis is good
- Layer numbering is clear
